news.title: Legora To Launch Ontology + AI Native Citator
Legora’s Vertical AI Playbook: From Zero to $100M ARR
Legora's Max Junestrand: from $1M to $100M ARR and the willingness to learn faster than anyone

bullets: Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the Enterprise surface area: data retention, audit logging, roles and permissions, ethical walls, metrics and ROI tracking…
Rethink how governance works in an AI-native world, defining how a platform built around AI agents can be controlled, audited, and trusted by the most security-conscious…
Build AI-native experiences for admin users, reimagining how administrators configure, monitor, and reason about their deployment rather than replicating legacy admin consoles.
Partner directly with CIOs, managing partners, and general counsels at some of the largest law firms and enterprises in the world to understand their requirements and turn them…
Work closely with design and engineering to ship secure, polished, high-quality capabilities with a strong bar for craft and reliability.
Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for our consumption-based pricing system, from the in-product experience to the underlying billing and metering infrastructure.
Build and operate the systems that reliably turn usage (tokens) into revenue (dollars), partnering closely with engineering on accuracy, transparency, and trust.
Own product pricing decisions: how and when we price newly released models, how we price features, and what is included, bundled, add-on, or metered.
Continuously evolve our monetization strategy to keep our incentives aligned with our customers’ and their end clients’.
Partner with go-to-market, finance, and leadership to translate pricing strategy into packaging, billing, and forecasting that scale.
